messages:
sophia: Quick postmortem follow-up — recurring midday GPU headroom drop last Wed. Root causes look like: quota exhaustion edges, scheduler backpressure on long jobs, and headroom calc using stale burst metrics. Need owners and short timelines. Can people ack and call dibs? :eyes:
raj: I can take scheduler tuning. Will try a conservative target_util change + tighter preemption window. ACTION-834: Raj to propose knob change by Fri EOD.
maya: I’ll own quota/backstop config. We currently allow users to request up to 120% of committed capacity during bursts which is hitting quota hard. ACTION-835: Maya to draft quota floor + burst cap (suggest 25% headroom) by Mon.
linus: I’ll run a quick sweep of recent long-running jobs that block slots and add a cheap circuit-breaker. If we can preempt or evict <10% of oldest low-priority jobs we gain headroom fast. ACTION-836: Linus to add eviction policy PR and perf test by next Tue.
eng-oncall-bot: incident-note: spike pattern detected 2024-05-11 12:15–12:45 UTC, 3x baseline. Linked logs: https://redwood/logs/incident/1723456789
sophia: Thx all. Two quick short-term mitigations I want in place this week: 1) a scheduler target_util drop from 0.7 -> 0.62 for midday window, 2) a soft quota cap for non-enterprise workspaces during 11:00–14:00 UTC. If someone wants a different split call it out now.
raj: Agree on target_util shift. I’ll also tighten the controller loop to reduce burst worker spin-up delay. Snippet for testing local config:
```
autoscaler:
  target_util: 0.62
  min_gpus: 12
  max_gpus: 80
  burst_quota_fraction: 0.25
  preemption_window_secs: 45
```
maya: For quota windows I'll suggest: reserved_commitment + min(25% of commit, 8 GPUs) as cap. Will post examples (customer A/B) in the doc.
linus: Also adding a metric alert for sustained queue-length > 150 for >5m so oncall gets earlier heads-up. ACTION-837: Linus to create alert and link to runbook by Thu.
sophia: Good. Can we also schedule a 30m sync next Wed to review the post-change telemetry and rollback plan? I’ll own the calendar invite.
raj: Ack — will add tuning PR and perf numbers to the sync agenda.
maya: Ack — will prepare a comparison table of quotas before/after and customer impact notes.
eng-oncall-bot: task-update: ACTION-834 assigned to raj, ACTION-835 assigned to maya, ACTION-836 assigned to linus, ACTION-837 assigned to linus. Due dates: 1723629600 (2024-05-14) for ACTION-834, 1723792400 (2024-05-16) for ACTION-835, 1723878800 (2024-05-17) for ACTION-836, 1723792400 (2024-05-16) for ACTION-837.
sophia: Thanks — documenting owners in the postmortem follow-up doc and tagging remediation board. If anything slips, shout in this thread so we can reassign quickly. :thumbsup:
